title: The bee and the mustard flower

scenes.caption: A mustard field.
scenes.say: In a Punjab field, mustard flowers shine yellow in the morning sun.

scenes.caption: A bee arrives.
scenes.say: A bee buzzes in. She wants sweet nectar to drink.

scenes.caption: Pollen sticks.
scenes.say: Yellow pollen sticks to her furry body as she drinks.

scenes.caption: Another flower.
scenes.say: She flies to another flower. Some pollen touches the sticky stigma.

scenes.caption: Pollination!
scenes.say: That is pollination. Now the flower can make seeds.

scenes.caption: Seeds grow.
scenes.say: Weeks later, the flower has made seeds in a pod.

scenes.caption: A seed takes flight.
scenes.say: A sycamore seed spins away on its helicopter wing. It is dispersal!

scenes.caption: A new plant.
scenes.say: Far away, the seed germinates. A new plant begins!
